prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image1 is the SELECTED original NE workshop physical model; Image2 is the SELECTED SW half-turn with plain rear faces; Image3 is actual NW2x2 low-box/contact geometry only. Create ONE genuine NW3D physical view: a quarter turn from SW, three-quarter turn from NE. Never mirror or rotate a flat image.

CRITICAL VISIBLE FACES: The original single LARGE EMPTY SERVICE BAY is now on the LEFT-facing visible wall. It is the SAME bay from Image1, with same opening/interior/ochre threshold and same dark-blue upper glazing band. The RIGHT-facing visible wall is the plain cream REAR face from Image2, under the SAME continuous dark-blue upper glazing; NO hatch, doorway or additional opening there. The original small personnel hatch is on the FAR HIDDEN face. One large bay only, not two. Preserve real physical workshop identity.

Same LOW square2x2 cream/charcoal workshop, exact FOUR dark rectangular roof grilles, same four-panel flat cream roof, four corner supports, restrained ochre accents. Grilles now have their long axes DOWN-LEFT as required by this quarter turn from SW (SW grille axes were down-right). Maintain actual grille placements/count and physical dimensions. Fixed upper-left SCREEN light is unchanged as the3D building turns; do not mirror lighting.

STRICT2:1 dimetric orthographic26.565degree camera on BOTH world axes, no perspective or30degree camera. Physical low-box base contacts at1024guide scale NORTH(512,350), EAST(768,478), SOUTH(512,606), WEST(256,478); roof rises96guide pixels. Whole hardware fits native2x2 zone without projecting/flared feet, external roof overhang, extra apron, slab or foundation. Every whole base corner/contact visible.

ONE complete isolated NW original on square1024x1024 real transparent canvas with at least80px clearance on EVERY side. No guide colours/dots/text, labels, frame, magenta, outside shadow, ground/apron, scenery, annex, tower, extra machinery, cargo, rocket, pod, probe, craft, vehicle, people, road, track, water or additional views. Same chunky M1 pale cream/charcoal/dark-blue/ochre model. Final view: LARGE OPEN BAY LEFT, PLAIN REAR RIGHT, small hatch hidden, FOUR roof grilles aligned down-left, upper-left screen light.
